title: SyncPro: Synchronous Reasoning and Responding for Proactive Streaming Video Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2610.32132v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Proactive streaming video understanding requires assistants to track unfolding events and respond when a user's requested condition is met. To make these decisions, assistants must accumulate relevant evidence and reassess response conditions as new observations arrive. Existing work offers complementary capabilities for this process: proactive video assistants learn when to respond, while streaming video reasoning methods generate scheduled intermediate text to organize observations and support subsequent answers. Together, these capabilities provide a foundation for proactive reasoning, but how to coordinate ongoing reasoning with timely responses remains underexplored. In a direct adaptation, fixed reasoning intervals can trigger updates when nothing relevant has changed or postpone useful updates until the next scheduled step. translated_title: SyncPro：面向主动式流媒体视频理解的同步推理与响应
translated_abstract: 主动式流媒体视频理解要求助手能够追踪正在展开的事件，并在用户所请求的条件满足时做出响应。为了做出这些决策，助手必须积累相关证据，并在新观察到来时重新评估响应条件。现有工作为这一过程提供了互补的能力：主动式视频助手学会了何时响应，而流媒体视频推理方法则生成按计划安排的中间文本来组织观察结果并支持后续回答。这些能力共同为主动式推理奠定了基础，但如何协调持续进行的推理与及时的响应仍未得到充分探索。在直接适配的方式下，固定的推理间隔可能在没有相关变化发生时触发更新，或者将有用的更新推迟到下一个预定步骤。同时，共享同一条生成路径也将两个不同的需求耦合在一起：即为未来决策保留证据……
tldr: SyncPro提出了一种同步推理与响应的机制，解决了主动式流媒体视频理解中持续推理与及时响应难以协调的问题，避免了固定推理间隔导致的无谓更新或延迟响应。
en_tdlr: SyncPro introduces a synchronous reasoning-and-responding mechanism for proactive streaming video understanding, addressing the challenge of coordinating ongoing reasoning with timely responses and avoiding unnecessary updates or delayed responses caused by fixed reasoning intervals.
